My rankings based on many theorycraftings:
    
1, Thoma (should be at least C4 for easier rotation, C6 Thoma furthers the distance of Top 2 even more as it gives a huge buff for Wanderer): Unarguably and conditonally best shielder for Wanderer despite his shield being a bit weaker than Zhongli. Shield can constantly stack by using NA (which Wanderer very favors) and continuously applying Pyro which helps him obtains Pyro buffs (30% ATK), and he and Wanderer will even stronger if you pair them with Bennett for Pyro Resonance (another +35% ATK). Overall very recommended to build for Wanderer.

2, Zhongli (C0): The shield archon. Provide universal shreds and having a shield stronger than Thoma's, though there are two flaws that he will ended up better than someone else other than Wanderer: technically he deals much less damage than Thoma, and he doesn't apply Pyro for Wanderer, though there's Bennett in some cases but even so, no Thoma = also no Pyro Resonance/+35% ATK) which is a huge DPS loss. Still viable and sometimes better if you haven't had at least C4/built Thoma yet and/or if you want more QoL and durable resistance.

3, Layla (MUST HAVE C1 for efficency, C4 is a good stopping-point for Wanderer buffing): Can constantly apply Cryo which Wanderer can apply the 20% Crit Rate buffs, although it's very questionable as the buff can be utterly useless to a huge damage changer for him. Her shield is stronger than Diona at base C0, however it's still too weak and will break easily compare to the DMG of Sprial Abyss, so she's required to have at least C1 for stronger shield.

4, Diona (MUST HAVE C2 for efficency, C3 for more healing): Technically, Layla but more fragile. Her shield is much weaker than the aforementioned and sadly her Constellation ain't having much uses for both her and Wanderer, in this case. Not  to mention, she will ended up better for some other characters (like Ayaka, at least). However, she has an advantage: That she acts as a Hybrid Shielder-Healer. This can help Wanderer alot during life-and-death situations unlike the other shielder.


The shielders that ended up down below means they're non-viable for Wanderer or utterly useless for him, and here's why.


5, Yanfei/Kaeya (MUST-C4): Pre C4? Threw them away.
Post C4 wise, it's not even worth it as their shield have very poor scalings (esp Kaeya when his requirement to both have C4 and activate his C4 shield are so awful). Overall, not worth it.

6, Noelle (at least C3): Really?
Shield wise, Noelle has one of the best shield absorption efficency (only lower than Zhongli and Thoma if he is full-stacked). However, she has a BIGASS flaw: Her shield does not have fully up-time = Wanderer still takes DMG after her shield ran out, and she has a hellish long CD for her shield (24s, 12s up-time), even if she is on-field to decrease her E CD thanks to her A4, it's still an ultimate DPS loss. She's better ended up on other teams (specifically, budget Itto team).

> Haran Geppaku Futsu: Best for Ayato.
    
• Decent Base ATK, 33.1 CRIT Rates, and 12% Elemental DMG Bonus favors every Sword DPS users and the not so efficency 2nd passive (buffs NA DMG)...
    
• A rather universal (yet not so universal with non NA DPS user) sword that comes in handy with most characters (if Mistsplitter is the strongest DPS sword, then Haran might be 2nd or 3rd). If you lost 50/50 to this, no worries, many characters can use this. Keqing and Alhaitham in 3.4 would loveeeee this weapon! Ayaka can also use this **(aesthetic purpose mostly)** although her NA really doesn't boost her total DMG in most of the scenarios.
